about_short_description.short_description: Spruce is building a future where users control their identity and data across all digital interactions.

product.name: Credible Platform
product.description: A platform for issuing and verifying verifiable digital credentials such as mobile driver's licenses and digital IDs.

product.name: Digital IDs
product.description: Digital identity credentials issued to users for secure and privacy-preserving identity verification.

product.name: Digital Passes & Permits
product.description: Verifiable digital credentials for passes and permits issued to users for access control and authorization.

product.name: Digital Supply Chain Credentials
product.description: Verifiable digital credentials used to authenticate and verify supply chain participants and assets.

product.name: In-Person Verification
product.description: A method to verify digital credentials directly on a device during face-to-face interactions without contacting the issuer server.

product.name: Online Verification
product.description: A method to verify digital credentials remotely over the internet with holder consent and privacy controls.
